query_payload.rationale: Add radius-scaled packing, local chemical order, angular geometry and charge-transfer proxies; sample rare elements, pnictides and complex oxides.
Add radius-scaled geometry, packing and local bond chemistry; sample pnictides, nonoxide light-element networks and underrepresented rare-element chemistries.
Add local bonding, charge-transfer, packing and invariant shell geometry beyond Magpie; broaden hydride/nitride, scarce heavy-element and oxygen-free pnictide coverage.
Retain compression/electron density; add coordination, bond polarity, molecular contacts and angular geometry. Sample nitrides, oxygen-free pnictides and sparse heavy metals.
Retain short-bond signals; add packing, coordination, local polarity and angular descriptors. Target nitrogen, pnictides and H/P/Re chemistries for additional labels.
Retain short-bond signals; add packing, normalized coordination, angular and charge-transfer descriptors. Sample nitrogen, pnictide and complex heavy-element chemistries.
Combine bond polarity, local coordination, molecular motifs, packing and nominal electron balance; prioritize nitrogen chemistry, fluorides/phosphides and mixed-metal oxides.
Add coordination heterogeneity, isolation, packing, ionicity and chemical order; prioritize nitrogen, phosphorus and underrepresented alkali chemistry.
Add molecular-N topology, bond ionicity, coordination deficits, segregation and packing; target N-, P- and F-bearing chemistry associated with large validation errors.
Add molecular-N topology, packing, coordination heterogeneity and local chemical/directional imbalance. Sample remaining N, scarce P and transition-metal oxides.
Add polyanion demand, N coordination spread, O-O length, coordination disorder and packing. Target Rb nitrides, mixed nitrogen compounds and metal oxides.
Add topology-aware electron demand, nitrogen polarity, coordination heterogeneity and packing. Target sampling toward alkali nitrogen compounds, mixed nitrogen chemistry and heavy-anion salts.
Retain existing descriptors; add N coordination heterogeneity, bond-adjusted electron demand and oxyanion connectivity. Query scarce P, Rb and multivalent oxides; N is absent from the pool catalogue.
Replace two composition summaries with nitrogen topology, N-O bonding, heavy-p-block saturation and coordination spread. Query scarce phosphorus and error-prone Rb-N/N-O chemistry.
Add packing, nitrogen topology, and heteronuclear p-block connectivity. Sample available sparse-element and chalcogen/halide chemistries, plus unrestricted coverage.
Nitrogen motif geometry and local coordination/bond-length heterogeneity complement contact chemistry; oxide and heavy p-block sampling broadens coverage.
Add N–O bonding, finite p-block clusters, coordination heterogeneity and d-metal mixing to resolve distinct bonding regimes. Sample rare metals, selected oxides and nonoxides.
Add periodicity-aware p-block clusters and local polarity heterogeneity; sample multimetal, phosphorus, and mixed-oxide chemistry.
Add N-dimer topology, coordination heterogeneity and local polarity imbalance. Sample rare-metal, Rb and p-block environments; nitrogen is absent from the unlabeled catalogue.
Add packing, coordination heterogeneity, N–O/F bonding and metal valence mismatch; sample available rare metals and mixed-metal chemistries. N/P are absent from the pool.

final_fill.method: uniform without replacement on remaining POOL; fixed arm/seed RNG
